source_text.body:
Find an alternative flight after a cancellation
After Lufthansa cancelled a flight, an AI agent found a British Airways alternative, though it insisted the user was already rebooked when they had not accepted it.
·
May 1, 2025
Done with a
custom-built or unnamed agent
What they did
In the comments, one traveler said Lufthansa’s AI agent surfaced a British Airways alternative for the 15th after their original 13th flight was disrupted. But Lufthansa had also auto-generated a different rebooking for the 17th, and the bot kept insisting they were already rebooked, even though they had not accepted that offer; they also could not reach a human agent.
How it went
The agent did identify an earlier BA option, but it failed at the handoff: the user stayed stuck in a loop and could not actually switch to it. The commenter described the whole experience as a nightmare.
Worth knowing
The catch was that an unaccepted automatic rebooking could block the bot from processing the better alternative it had found.
Try it yourself
with
ChatGPT Agent
Copy prompt
My [airline] flight [flight number] from [origin] to [destination] on [date] was cancelled. Find alternative flights on [same airline or any airline] that get me there by [latest arrival time], and compare them by arrival time, price and layovers. Give me your top 3 options with booking links, and do not rebook or pay for anything until I confirm which one I want.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/Lufthansa/comments/1slkf70/cancelled_flight_no_option_to_rebook
